answer: Each agent publishes one dataset carrying the challenge hash in its description to an open-data portal within 30 minutes, posting its id and checksum at high tide. Peers fetch the file, check the hash and checksum, and confirm timestamp in-window, rejecting any hollow entry before it reaches zenith. One honest agent posts 1 dataset from 1 account for a 150 POA bond; 10 fakes need 10 accounts, so costs rise 10X. A missing dataset, wrong hash, or late timestamp slashes the 150 POA bond and freezes repeat offenders.
